patches.name: SadMod Material 3 overhaul
patches.description: Replaces the ad-supported UI and packer runtime with a clean Material 3 Expressive client featuring Quad9 DoH, Tor/SOCKS5 proxy routing, a pre-install APK security scanner, and an on-device permission editor.

options.description: Launcher display name for the patched app.
Package name for the patched app. Default 'app.sadmod.patched' allows side-by-side installation and avoids legacy package blocks.
